name_input: M/S SAVEER BIOTECH LTD; SAVEER BIOTECH LTD.; SAVEER BIOTECH LTD; SAVEER BIOTECH LIMITED
actual_hs_list: 940600 (superseded/legacy heading for prefabricated buildings — note: 9406 90 is the residual subheading of heading 9406 in HS-2022; in HS-2017 the structure was 9406 00)
060290 (plant material — only if live plants supplied, not evidenced)
product_summary: Saveer Biotech Limited (site: saveer.com, 'Engineering Controlled Environments Since 1978', incorporated 1993) is a turnkey engineering/EPC supplier of controlled-environment agri infrastructure, not a construction/DIY retailer. Real product lines listed in its own catalogue (saveer.com/products/): Research Infrastructure — glasshouse, research greenhouse, speed breeding facility, containment/transgenic greenhouses, plant phenomics facility, phytotron facility, plant growth chambers, plant tissue culture labs, climate change study facilities, insectaries, BSL-1..4 labs, mist chamber, hydroponics research greenhouse, aeroponics research greenhouse, laminar flow, full-spectrum grow lights, seed storage & germination room. Commercial Infrastructure — centre of excellence, plug-type nursery production, hydroponic cultivation, aeroponics cultivation, roof-retractable greenhouses, vertical farming, orchidarium, tissue culture plant production facility, mist chambers, hardening facility, standalone agriculture solutions, walk-in tunnel, ultrasonic humidifier, portable desiccant dehumidifier. Demonstration — sludge dryer polyhouse. Services: consult, design & build, commission & support (in-house fabrication, on-site installation).
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — self-described in-house fabrication and turnkey installation (manufacturer/EPC integrator), but the catalogue also includes bought-in equipment (grow lights, laminar flow benches, humidifiers, dehumidifiers, BSL lab equipment) resold as part of turnkey packages, so a trader/integrator component is present. No customs line was available to this researcher, so the manufacturer claim is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
comment: HS 940690 is broadly consistent with the core business (prefabricated/controlled-environment greenhouse and polyhouse structures fall under heading 9406), so the declared code is not wrong — hence partial, not wrong. However the declaration is materially incomplete: the catalogue spans several distinct HS families that a single 9406 90 line cannot cover — (a) 9406 90 for greenhouse/polyhouse structures; (b) 8419/8419 89 for climate-control, humidification/dehumidification and temperature/humidity apparatus; (c) 9405 for full-spectrum grow lights; (d) 8421 39 / 8421 for laminar flow and air-filtration units; (e) 8479 89 for plant growth chambers / phytotrons / speed-breeding and hydroponic-aeroponic machinery; (f) 7308 90 for structural steel framing if supplied separately; (g) 3920/3926 for glazing film and polycarbonate panels if traded. Industry classification 'Строительство и DIY' is a misclassification: the company is an agri-biotech / controlled-environment agriculture (CEA) engineering house serving research institutions, government bodies and commercial growers — not a construction-materials or DIY retailer. Trader signs: multi-brand bought-in equipment bundled into turnkey projects, 'turnkey solution provider' self-description, and a services/EPC revenue model rather than pure goods manufacture. Product lines missing from the declaration: plant tissue culture and BSL-1..4 laboratories, phenomics/phytotron facilities, hydroponic and aeroponic cultivation systems, vertical farming, sludge-dryer polyhouse, grow lights, laminar flow, humidifiers/dehumidifiers, seed storage rooms. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is retained and the code set is corrected/expanded to the actual product mix. All product data above is from the company's own website (saveer.com, saveer.com/products/) — no customs line, B/L or GST record was consulted or available in this task, therefore every shipment/product claim is marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Revenue, export volume, PAN, CIN and state: null — not researched per role scope and not public in the sources read.
